description: Change a finished video in plain words, or ask about it. Exact edits (crop, reframe, titles, transitions, timing, music, colours, captions, cuts) go first to the free canvas tools: get_timeline and get_screenshot, then put_overlay, write_graphic, update_layer, cut, set_captions, set_audio, set_look. A change asked for in words costs 1 to 2 credits (dry_run: true says the cost); for broad creative changes. It can restyle, add b-roll and sound effects, hold the camera, add a shape, switch the style, export, share, rewrite the script or change the narrator. Transitions: write_graphic scenes or set_look. Questions are answered from the frames. Not by chat yet: speed changes, splitting or looping, copy_style. Answers with a job_id: check_video shows the steps and reply. A change that cannot be done leaves the video as it was.

attachments.description: Up to four still images, each with intent reference_only or use_in_video: a ChatGPT file, an asset_staging_key from import_asset or an owned asset_id.

base_version.description: The version to change; the live one when left out.

change.description: The change or question, in the user's words. To add a voiceover, start with 'Narrator: liam\nNarration: <the exact script>' and then anything else to change.

dry_run.description: true: say what the change uses and send nothing.

output_id.description: Change only this output (a hook, a Short or a format) from check_video.

video_id.description: The video to change, from list_videos or check_video.

voice.description: A new narrator for a video made from words. Leave out when adding a voiceover.

name: revise_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint revise_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Request a video change
